title: the guest is the designated test machine on the expected boot, x86_64, with systemd
group rosetun and two distinct ordinary accounts exist, both in the group, neither an administrator
no Rosetun package, unit, helper process, installed files or nftables table rosetun exist
/usr/sbin/nft, curl with tftp, dig, dpkg and cgroup v2 are present
without Rosetun the probe address answers HTTPS on the physical interface and the host node answers
dpkg installs the previous package on the clean guest with every dependency already present
the helper runs in its leaf and is enabled, the boot unit is enabled and idle, the group exists, Lockdown is offered
the menu entry, the rosetun:// handler in the desktop database, the icons and the polkit policy are in place
running postinst configure twice more keeps the same helper process
the stand's counter sees a packet that leaves for the probe when nothing blocks it
dpkg upgrades during a kill-switch session: the table never goes and no packet reaches the probe past the tunnel
after the upgrade the new version runs, reports the hold and refuses HTTPS on the physical interface and by the route
rosetun connect lifts the hold through the tunnel, and the disconnect opens the network
an upgrade under Lockdown keeps Lockdown: the record, the table and the refusal stay, and no hold is reported
with reset-firewall made to fail dpkg --remove stops, prints the way out, keeps the files and keeps the network closed
dpkg --remove under Lockdown opens the network and removes the programs, the units' links and the table
dpkg --purge removes /var/lib/rosetun and keeps the group
